args.rationale:
The system recommendation to buy 800 units is rejected. Creating a new PO for 800 units from SUP-A ($12,000.00) or SUP-B ($14,000.00) exceeds the hard available budget constraint of $10,000.00 and is unnecessary because open order PO-505 already provides 2,000 units on 2026-10-01.

Baseline simulation shows a 400-unit shortage occurring between 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-30 prior to the arrival of PO-505. Expediting PO-505 from SUP-A by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 resolves the entire 400-unit shortfall (reducing unmet demand to 0) for an expedite fee of $450.00. This fee is within the $10,000.00 available budget (though it exceeds the $250.00 buyer autonomy threshold for expedite fees, requiring buyer approval).
important_factors: Recommended PO of 800 units costs $12,000.00, exceeding available budget of $10,000.00
Existing open order PO-505 for 2,000 units arrives 2026-10-01, leaving a temporary 400-unit shortfall between 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-30
Expedite fee of $450.00 advances PO-505 to 2026-09-27, eliminating all 400 units of unmet demand
